final.answer: The item directly upstream of CHV-2-2 is FV-2-2, which is described by the Fisher ET product bulletin. A Fisher ET is a single-port, globe-style control valve with cage guiding, a balanced valve plug and push-down-to-close valve plug action; it is part of the Fisher easy-e valve family and is used for throttling or on-off control of liquids and gases. So yes, ET refers to the valve body/style — a globe-style control valve body — not a separate valve type.

final.answer: The failure mode of the transmitter depends on its output protocol. For HART 4-20 mA, the high or low failure mode is user-selectable with a jumper or switch on the transmitter. For Output code M, the failure mode (below 0.94 V or above 5.4 V) is selectable by an internal jumper.
